How to order

Four simple steps to someone's smile

No account, no checkout. Just a quick WhatsApp chat with us.

Start my order

  1. Choose your bouquet

    Browse the Mini, Classic or Luxe collections.

  2. Message us

    Tap the WhatsApp button and tell us what you want.

  3. Confirm your order

  4. Receive your flowers
